title: Completed CONTRACTOR STATUS REPORT Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed CONTRACTOR STATUS REPORT artifact data payloads (PMO-06.03).

contractor.description: The legal name and contact details of the contractor performing the contract.

contract_number_and_type.description: The official contract identifier and contract type (e.g., Fixed Price, T&M).

reporting_period.description: The start and end calendar dates covered by this contractor report.

report_submission_date.description: The exact date on which the report was officially submitted to the project manager.

scope_status_this_period.description: Assessment of contracted scope deliverables completed or in progress during this period.

scope_variance_and_cause.description: Explanation of any deviations from contracted scope baselines and their root causes.

quality_status_this_period.description: Evaluation of deliverable quality against contracted standards and specifications.

quality_variance_and_cause.description: Root causes and details of any non-conformance or failed quality checks.

schedule_status_this_period.description: Assessment of progress against contracted milestone dates and schedule baselines.

schedule_variance_and_cause.description: Root cause explanation for any schedule delays or accelerations.

cost_status_this_period.description: Assessment of contract billings and expenditures against the financial plan.

cost_variance_and_cause.description: Root cause explanation for any financial variances or billing discrepancies.

estimated_completion_date_estimate.description: The contractor projected delivery and contract completion date.

estimated_completion_date_basis.description: Basis and rationale supporting the estimated completion date.

estimated_final_cost_estimate.description: Projected total final cost at completion (applicable to cost-reimbursable contracts).

estimated_final_cost_basis.description: Basis and historical cost rate data supporting the estimated final cost.

key_forecast_assumptions_estimate.description: Summary of key assumptions underpinning forecast values.

key_forecast_assumptions_basis.description: Dependencies and external conditions supporting forecast stability.

claims_or_disputes.description: Summary of any new, pending, or resolved contractual claims or disputes.

risks.description: Key vendor-side risks that could impact contract milestones or deliverables.

planned_corrective_or_preventive_action.description: Specific remedial actions planned by the contractor to recover performance variances.

issues.description: Current active roadblocks, technical issues, or dependencies affecting execution.

escalations.description: Items requiring urgent decisions or dispute intervention from the buyer or PMO.

contract_change_requests.description: Summary of formal contract change proposals submitted, reviewed, or pending.

comments.description: Additional context, contractor remarks, or explanatory notes.
